questions.cardText:
[Theater] Which of the following best describes Japanese Noh theater?
A. It usually depicts folklore about romance, revenge, and loyalty
B. It focuses on spiritual themes and supernatural beings
C. It is a comedy
Answer: B. Noh theater, which originated in the 14th century, is one of Japan’s oldest performing arts. The actors often wear masks to portray various characters, including gods, spirits, and demons. Before putting on the mask, an actor often looks at it until they feel their individuality is entirely overtaken by the character they are about to portray.
questions.de: Auf welche Art von Wesen konzentriert sich das japanische Nō-Theater, in dem maskierte Darsteller etwa Götter, Geister und Dämonen verkörpern, typischerweise?
questions.en: On what kind of beings does Japanese Noh theatre, whose masked actors portray gods, spirits and demons, typically focus?

timeline.labelEn: Noh, Japan's oldest major theatre art still regularly performed, develops from sarugaku in the 14th century
timeline.labelDe: Das Nō, Japans älteste noch regelmäßig gespielte große Theaterkunst, entsteht im 14. Jahrhundert aus dem Sarugaku

questions.notes: Wikipedia: Noh is often based on tales featuring a supernatural being transformed into a human hero who narrates the story; performed since the 14th century. Card's answer is fine.

questions.cardText:
[Physiology and Anatomy] Enzymes in the human body act as:
A. Stimulant B. Hormones C. Catalysts
Answer: C.
questions.de: Welche Rolle spielen Enzyme bei den chemischen Reaktionen im menschlichen Körper?
questions.en: What role do enzymes play in the chemical reactions of the human body?

timeline.labelEn: Anselme Payen discovers the first enzyme, diastase
timeline.labelDe: Anselme Payen entdeckt mit der Diastase das erste Enzym

questions.notes: Enzymes are biological catalysts that speed up reactions without being consumed (Wikipedia).
